about: Build log of the landmarks of Central Dublin (tools/build-place-landmarks.mjs): fetch records and the dataflow activities landmark-select and landmark-tiles with input and output hashes and counts.

overture-religious.request: DuckDB read_parquet over HTTPS of the 512 files of the release, filter on bbox and: subtype = 'religious' OR class IN ('mosque','church','cathedral','chapel','synagogue','temple','shrine','religious','monastery','bell_tower','tower','clock_tower') OR roof_shape IN ('dome','onion','cone') OR has_parts
overture-religious.use: positions only, to choose the OSM boxes (the OSM answers give the tags and geometry)

overture-parts.request: DuckDB read_parquet over HTTPS of the 3 files of the release, filter on bbox and: none
overture-parts.use: positions only, to choose the OSM boxes (the OSM answers give the tags and geometry)

overture-worship.request: DuckDB read_parquet over HTTPS of the 16 files of the release, filter on bbox and: basic_category ILIKE '%mosque%' OR basic_category ILIKE '%church%' OR basic_category ILIKE '%synagog%' OR basic_category ILIKE '%relig%' OR basic_category ILIKE '%worship%' OR basic_category ILIKE '%cathedral%'
overture-worship.use: positions only, to choose the OSM boxes; not drawn, not committed

qlever-tall.request: SPARQL POST (text/tab-separated-values): PREFIX osmkey: <https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:> PREFIX osmrel: <https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/> PREFIX ogc: <http://www.opengis.net/rdf#> PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#> SELECT ?e ?mm ?hist ?h ?name ?wkt WHERE { osmrel:62273 ogc:sfContains ?e . ?e osmkey:height ?h . OPTIONAL { ?e osmkey:man_made ?mm } OPTIONAL { ?e osmkey:historic ?hist } OPTIONAL { ?e osmkey:name ?name } FILTER(?mm IN ("chimney", "obelisk", "tower", "monument", "mast") || ?hist IN ("monument", "memorial")) ?e geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?wkt . }
qlever-tall.use: positions only, to choose the OSM boxes (the OSM answers give the tags and geometry)

osm-landmarks.stored_as: the elements of all answers merged by type and id, sorted, gzip JSON (sha256 above)

activities.note: outputs under data/raw are intermediate (not committed); their hashes fix the next step
